stable_traits.physical_traits: Tall man just into his middle years, handsome once, hair already more white than brown, face lined by strain and worry, dark eyes that had seen too much
stable_traits.filiations: Husband of Ilyena Sunhair, father to multiple children (all deceased)
stable_traits.personality: Once proud and confident in his abilities, believing men could match the Creator; now shattered by grief and guilt over killing his own family while mad

aliases_observed.notes: Name given by men, referenced by prophecy
Name given after this day for killing his family
Used by Elan Morin when addressing him

characters.notes: Wore the Ring of Tamyrlin, sat in the High Seat, summoned the Nine Rods of Dominion, stood first among the Servants. Used saidin (male half of the True Source) which has been tainted by the Shadow's counterstroke. In his madness from the taint, killed his wife Ilyena and all his family. Creates Dragonmount by drawing too much of the One Power and immolating himself.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Not so tall as Lews Therin, clothed all in black except for snow-white lace at throat and silverwork on turned-down tops of thigh-high boots
stable_traits.personality: Arrogant, cruel, scornful, embraces the name Betrayer of Hope that was meant to revile him; serves Shai'tan (the Great Lord of the Dark)

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: Serves Shai'tan (the Great Lord of the Dark), follows 'a different power now'

aliases_observed.notes: Name given by men, which he embraces

characters.notes: Was once among those who could Heal but was never very skilled at it; now follows a different power and can perform Shai'tan's healing. Has fought Lews Therin across many turnings of the Wheel. Claims the war has lasted since the beginning of time. Was humbled by Lews Therin in the Hall of Servants and defeated at the Gates of Paaran Disen.

stable_traits.personality: Enjoyed conversation, would ask many questions

aliases_observed.notes: Shortened form used by Lews Therin

characters.notes: Already dead at the start of the chapter, killed by Lews Therin in his madness. Her body lies in the palace.

appearances.whereabouts: Wandering the ruined palace, then travels to a flat empty land by a river where he creates Dragonmount
appearances.notable_actions: Wanders the palace in madness calling for Ilyena, unaware he killed her and everyone he loved; is 'healed' by Elan Morin which restores his sanity and memory; realizes what he has done; travels away from the palace; draws deeply on saidin and immolates himself, creating a mountain
appearances.demeanor: Initially mad and unaware, speaking nonsense about guests and singing; after healing, transitions to grief-stricken horror and suicidal despair
alliances_shown: Once stood first among the Servants
Led the Hundred Companions in attack on the Great Lord of the Dark

appearances.whereabouts: Appears in the palace via Traveling (air rippling and solidifying), later appears on the island after Dragonmount is created
appearances.notable_actions: Comes to confront Lews Therin; performs dark healing to restore Lews Therin's sanity so he will know his defeat; taunts him about killing his own family; offers to have the Great Lord bring Ilyena back if Lews Therin serves him; appears on the island after the mountain is created and vows their conflict continues
appearances.demeanor: Scornful, arrogant, cruel, fastidious (avoiding the dead bodies), taking satisfaction in Lews Therin's suffering
alliances_shown: Serves Shai'tan/the Great Lord of the Dark

appearances.whereabouts: Body lies dead in the palace
appearances.notable_actions: None (already dead); her body shifts when the floor shakes

relationships.description: Husband and wife; Lews Therin killed her in his madness from the taint
Ancient enemies who have fought across many turnings of the Wheel; Lews Therin humbled Elan Morin in the Hall of Servants and defeated him at the Gates of Paaran Disen
